evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking change. The `--spawn-server` flag is still accepted on macOS; it now prints a warning instead of attempting to spawn `lemond` (which failed before). Linux behavior is unchanged. Existing scripts and user habits are unaffected.
evidence.documentation: Documentation is complete and consistent. `docs/dev/getting-started.md` was updated to say `--spawn-server` is 'Linux only; ignored with a warning on macOS'. `docs/guide/configuration/README.md` adds a new `## lemonade-tray CLI (Linux/macOS)` section listing all flags, and documents `--spawn-server` as 'Linux only' with a note that on macOS the flag is accepted but ignored because the LaunchDaemon runs `lemond`.
evidence.manual_release_testing: The `--spawn-server` flag on `lemonade-tray` is user-reachable on macOS. Running `lemonade-tray --spawn-server` should print 'Warning: --spawn-server is not supported on macOS and will be ignored.' to stderr and start in disconnected mode. The original failure was validated during v2026.41 candidate testing; however, the fix's warning message and disconnected startup were not independently confirmed on a v2026.42 candidate build. The risk is low (it's a single warning line plus flag clearing), but this path has no macOS CI coverage.
evidence.post_approval_commits: None. The PR had two commits (both authored by @ramkrishna2910 with Claude Opus 5.5 as co-author). The approval from @Geramy was submitted at 2026-10-06T16:19:04Z against the tip commit 3d231d15577d03ca877d88e6cf8034920f19e4aa, and no commits were added after approval. The merge happened at 2026-10-06T17:24:34Z.
evidence.review: PR #3756 was approved by @Geramy (MEMBER), who has 'mac, security' listed as a subject area in docs/dev/contribute.md. The approval comment was a single line: 'looks good, thanks!'. The change is extremely small (7 lines in C++, 2 documentation files, 1 line deleted), so brevity is proportionate. @abn was requested as a reviewer but did not review. No inline comments were generated by CodeRabbit or humans.
evidence.security: No security concerns. The change adds a platform guard and a stderr warning. No network calls, credential handling, permission changes, or new execution paths.
evidence.tests: No unit or integration tests were added. The change is a `#ifdef __APPLE__` guard that sets `spawn_server = false` and prints a warning. The fix was originally triggered by `lemonade-tray --spawn-server` failing during v2026.41 candidate testing on macOS, so the behavior was observed in the wild. Automated CI skipped `Test CLI/Endpoints (macos-latest)` and `Test .dmg - macOS inference`, but `macOS builds` passed successfully.

subject: fix(tray): make --spawn-server a no-op on macOS (#3756)
summary: Makes the `lemonade-tray --spawn-server` flag a no-op on macOS (prints a warning and starts in disconnected mode instead of spawning `lemond`), adds a `lemonade-tray` CLI section to the configuration guide, and updates the dev doc to document the `--spawn-server` option as Linux-only on macOS.
verdict_reason: Minimal, well-scoped platform guard reviewed by someone with macOS subject-area expertise, with complete documentation and no post-approval changes.
